mapper.sql: M.CODE_SECT, M.CODE_SECT_NM, M.DESC1, M.DESC2, M.DESC3, M.DESC4, M.DESC5, M.TASK_SECT, RTRIM(M.PRC_SECT) AS PRC_SECT, RTRIM(M.USED_YN) AS USED_YN, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CODE_DTL D WHERE D.CODE_SECT = M.CODE_SECT) AS DETAIL_COUNT, M.CRT_DTM, M.CRT_CMENO, M.LSCHG_DTM, M.LS_CMENO
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TB_CODE_MASTER M
(UPPER(M.CODE_SECT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{s.q}) || '%' OR M.CODE_SECT_NM LIKE '%' || #{s.q} || '%')
AND M.USED_YN = CAST(#{s.usedYn} AS CHAR(1))
ORDER BY M.CODE_SECT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CODE_MASTER ( CODE_SECT, CODE_SECT_NM, DESC1, DESC2, DESC3, DESC4, DESC5, TASK_SECT, PRC_SECT, USED_YN, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO ) VALUES ( #{codeSect}, #{codeSectNm}, #{desc1}, #{desc2}, #{desc3}, #{desc4}, #{desc5}, #{taskSect}, #{prcSect}, #{usedYn}, #{crtDtm}, #{crtCmeno}, #{lschgDtm}, #{lsCmeno} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CODE_MASTER SET CODE_SECT_NM = #{codeSectNm}, DESC1 = #{desc1}, DESC2 = #{desc2}, DESC3 = #{desc3}, DESC4 = #{desc4}, DESC5 = #{desc5}, TASK_SECT = #{taskSect}, PRC_SECT = #{prcSect}, USED_YN = #{usedYn}, LSCHG_DTM = #{lschgDtm}, LS_CMENO = #{lsCmeno} WHERE CODE_SECT = #{codeSect}
mapper.sql: CODE_SECT, CODE, CODE_NM, DATA1, DATA2, DATA3, DATA4, RTRIM(DATA5) AS DATA5, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_CODE_DTL WHERE CODE_SECT = #{codeSect} ORDER BY CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CODE_DTL ( CODE_SECT, CODE, CODE_NM, DATA1, DATA2, DATA3, DATA4, DATA5, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO ) VALUES ( #{codeSect}, #{code}, #{codeNm}, #{data1}, #{data2}, #{data3}, #{data4}, #{data5}, #{crtDtm}, #{crtCmeno}, #{lschgDtm}, #{lsCmeno} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CODE_DTL SET CODE_NM = #{codeNm}, DATA1 = #{data1}, DATA2 = #{data2}, DATA3 = #{data3}, DATA4 = #{data4}, DATA5 = #{data5}, LSCHG_DTM = #{lschgDtm}, LS_CMENO = #{lsCmeno} WHERE CODE_SECT = #{codeSect} AND CODE = #{code}
